page.seoTitle: Managed AI Agents for Business | Páramo
page.seoDescription: AI agents built on the tools your business already uses, then monitored, maintained and improved by us. Lead replies, follow-ups, records and reports.
page.title: AI agents that work for your business, run by us.
page.lede: Agents built around your business that answer, follow up, report and keep work moving. We monitor them, improve them and maintain them so you do not have to.

forWho.title: Who it is for
forWho.intro: Businesses with repeat work that follows the same steps every time, and no one free to build or babysit an AI system.
signs: New inquiries wait because one person handles them by hand.
Information gets typed from one system into another.
Follow-ups and reports happen when someone remembers.
You want it running on your own tools, with a person approving what goes to customers.

items.name: Agents built on your tools
items.body: Connected to the email, customer records, accounting and documents you already use.

items.name: A person in the loop
items.body: Anything a customer sees is drafted for someone on your team to approve, until you choose otherwise.

items.name: A simple record
items.body: Each run reports what it did, so you can see the work without opening the system.

items.name: Monitoring and upkeep
items.body: We watch it, fix what breaks, and keep it current as your business changes. It stays yours.

steps.title: Pick
steps.body: We choose one job worth handing off first, like answering after-hours calls or chasing overdue invoices.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: We build the agent on the tools you already use and connect it to the information it needs.

steps.title: Test
steps.body: It works alongside your team first. Nothing goes out until someone on your side has checked it.

steps.title: Launch
steps.body: Once it gets the job right, it runs on its own, and you see a simple record of what it did.

steps.title: Improve
steps.body: We watch it, fix what breaks, keep it current as your business changes, and add the next agent when you are ready.

examples.title: What it looks like in practice
examples.intro: A few agents we have built and run:

items.body: Every new inquiry is matched to the right confidentiality agreement, logged in HubSpot and drafted as a Gmail reply for a person to send. Two weeks after launch the broker was approving replies from his phone.
Website leads now land in QuickBooks on their own, checked for duplicates, with a report on every run.
Every evening at 6pm, the day’s client meetings are summarized and filed in the right client folder.

faq.q: Will the agent talk to our customers on its own?
faq.a: Not at first. It drafts, a person approves. Automatic sending is a later choice, made after weeks of drafts that work.
On the tools and accounts you already have. Nothing is hidden in a platform you cannot see.
Monitoring is part of the service. We fix it, and each run’s report shows you what happened.
Yes. It is built in your accounts and documented.
